description:
Position: Server-Side Developer 
 Location: Everett, Washington 
 Duration: 6 Months C2H
 Rate: Open
 

 Job Description:               
                
  We need a Server-Side Developer for our direct client in Everett, WA. 
  The ideal candidate will work in a team environment to develop web applications using the Microsoft stack of technologies.
  Our team does end to end development and so they will require the ability to work across all application layers. 
  The ideal candidate needs to have a passion for using technology to meet the needs of the end users and improve business operations in a fast paced working environment. 
  Any telephone or telecommunications experience is preferred. 
 

 Required Skills:
 

 • C#, MVC, Web API, JavaScript, and TFS
 • Unit Test Automation
 • SQL Server and IIS configurations  
 • Design skills to translate requirements into UI Design.
 • Code review and great team spirit
 • Awareness of overall process and assist others with the process.
 • Participate in design and requirement gathering meetings.
 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
